strategy.summary: Shoot the far-left spinner whenever the X card lights it for 2,000 per spin. Otherwise, hit numbered drop targets to fill the three bingo cards and advance carried Bonus X and Reserve Bonus.

steps.text: Test the far-left spinner from both right-side flippers. Watch the upper-saucer exit and full top-lane feed.
Read which X, Y, or Z bingo card is active.
modeNotes: Active card: Top lanes, the upper pop bumper, the center star rollover, and slingshots rotate the selected card on stock code.

steps.text: When X is active, shoot the far-left spinner.
modeNotes: Lit far-left spinner: Each spin scores 2,000. The shot feeds the upper saucer and then the top B-I-G lanes.

steps.text: When the far-left spinner is not lit, hit a numbered drop that advances the active bingo card.
modeNotes: Bingo number: A target lights its number on every active card. Each lit number adds 1,000 to base bonus.

steps.text: Choose drops that complete three-in-a-row lines or a full card.
modeNotes: 2x Bonus: Complete one card, or make one line on each of the three cards.
3x Bonus: Complete two cards, or make two lines on each of the three cards.

steps.text: Use the upper saucer as an added collect on the spinner route.
modeNotes: Upper saucer: It scores 5,000 per lit B-I-G G-A-M-E letter, plus 25,000 after completing the word on stock code.

steps.text: Repeat the lit-spinner and drop-target route. Base bonus and Bonus X carry between balls.
After all three cards are complete, protect the permanent Reserve Bonus instead of forcing another dangerous target.

fallback.title: Numbered drop targets
fallback.when: Use this plan when the far-left spinner or its full feed is unsafe.

steps.text: Read the active bingo card before each controlled target shot.
Complete the numbered bank with the most useful missing squares.
Hit numbered drop targets until every card has one completed line for 2x. Continue until every card has two completed lines for 3x.
Complete all three cards for the permanent 27,000 Reserve Bonus.
modeNotes: Reserve Bonus: A completed set of all three cards adds 27,000 to the end-of-ball bonus on this and later balls.

steps.text: After all three versions of one numbered bank are lit, a later bank completion scores 25,000.

alternatives.title: B-I-G G-A-M-E and upper saucer
alternatives.when: Use this plan when the far-left spinner reliably reaches the top.

steps.text: Collect B, I, and the first G at the top lanes.
Collect the second G and A at the two left standups. Collect M and E at the inlanes.
A completed B-I-G lights the inner-left spinner for 1,000 per spin.
A full word lights Extra Ball at the left side lane. A second word lights Special there.
Shoot the far-left spinner and upper saucer for the letter value and the stock completion award.

alternatives.title: Inner-left spinner
alternatives.when: Use this plan when its backhand is clean and X is active.

steps.text: Backhand the inner-left spinner from the left flipper.
A lit spinner scores 1,000 per spin.
Prefer the far-left 2,000 spinner when both shots are safe.

buildsToward.title: Reserve Bonus and carried Bonus X

steps.text: Use numbered drops to build the X, Y, and Z cards.
Make one line on each card or one full card for 2x.
Make two lines on each card or two full cards for 3x.
Complete all three cards for a permanent 27,000 Reserve Bonus.

checkBeforePlay: Identify stock code or BigGame2022 RPU; its prey hunt, skill shot, card selection, hurry-ups, ball save, and Jackpot are not stock.
Confirm which ball enables the 5,000-per-line bonus and whether Extra Ball and Special convert to points.
Verify the upper-saucer stock completion award: stock code uses 25,000, while some modern replacements use 35,000.

techniques.name: Backhand
techniques.instruction: Test a left-flipper backhand into the inner-left spinner. Prefer it to the right-flipper forehand when the backhand is clean.

techniques.name: Far-left spinner from paired flippers
techniques.instruction: Test both right-side flippers. A rolling lower-flipper shot can work. Strike very late, near the tip, from the upper flipper.

techniques.name: Pseudo-post pass
techniques.instruction: Bounce the ball from a lower flipper off the underside of the upper flipper to move it across the game. Test the geometry before using it with a lead.

techniques.name: Dead bounce
techniques.instruction: Let a controlled feed cross the wide lower-flipper area to the opposite side. Use the extra flipper surface only after the bounce is known.

cautions.issue: Target and lane shots create more side-to-side movement than the far-left spinner.
cautions.response: Return to the far-left spinner whenever it is lit and its feed is controlled.

cautions.issue: The upper-right and center-left chute feeds can drain through the center at the wrong speed.
cautions.response: Watch each full feed before trapping or dead-bouncing it.

cautions.issue: Balls can hop between the paired flippers when a metal barrier is missing.
cautions.response: Check the barriers below both upper flippers before using the wide dead-bounce area.

cautions.issue: Oblique side feeds can pass the sling and side post.
cautions.response: Keep the opposite flipper ready. Do not depend on a late outlane save.

quickInfo.name: Main route
quickInfo.summary: Shoot the far-left spinner whenever the X card lights it for 2,000 per spin.

quickInfo.name: Long goal
quickInfo.summary: Use numbered drops to build the X, Y, and Z cards.

quickInfo.name: Safer fallback
quickInfo.summary: Numbered drop targets: Use this plan when the far-left spinner or its full feed is unsafe.

strategy.simpleOverview: In stock Big Game, the active X, Y, or Z card determines which numbered drops advance useful bingo patterns. Shoot the far-left spinner whenever X lights it for 2,000 per spin; otherwise use controlled numbered drops to complete card lines and build carried Bonus X and Reserve Bonus.
strategy.overview: Stock Big Game alternates between a lit far-left spinner and numbered drops that fill the active X, Y, or Z bingo card. Read the active card, repeat the spinner whenever X lights it, and choose drops that complete three-in-a-row lines or a full card. Protect the carried Bonus X and permanent Reserve Bonus after all three cards are complete.
machineSetup: Identify stock code or BigGame2022 RPU; its prey hunt, skill shot, card selection, hurry-ups, ball save, and Jackpot are not stock.
Confirm which ball enables the 5,000-per-line bonus and whether Extra Ball and Special convert to points.
Verify the upper-saucer stock completion award: stock code uses 25,000, while some modern replacements use 35,000.

strategy.summary: Use a top lane to launch prey, select its flashing card with the pop bumpers, then hit the matching numbered drop twice to flush and collect it. Build card lines and B-I-G G-A-M-E progress alongside that hunt.

quickInfo.name: Skill shot
quickInfo.summary: A flashing top lane begins each ball; side 10-point switches raise its value before the ball enters a lane.

quickInfo.name: Prey hunt
quickInfo.summary: A top lane launches prey; select its card, hit the matching drop to flush it, then hit that number again for 20,000.

quickInfo.name: Scoring cards
quickInfo.summary: Pop bumpers select X, Y, and Z; numbered drops light their matching squares on every selected card.

quickInfo.name: Drop hurry-up
quickInfo.summary: When enabled, finish a started three-bank before it resets; liberal clear can award that bank on every card.

quickInfo.name: B-I-G G-A-M-E Jackpot
quickInfo.summary: Complete the letters, then use the upper-left lane and saucer for letter value plus an optional timed 100,000 Jackpot.

steps.text: Use the side 10-point switches to raise the flashing-lane skill shot, then plunge through the lit top lane.
Read the prey's flashing number and X, Y, or Z card before choosing a target.
Use the lower-left bumper for X, lower-right for Y, or five upper-bumper hits for Z.
Hit the numbered drop matching the prey to flush it, then hit that number again to collect the 20,000 award.
When a drop-bank hurry-up begins, complete that three-bank only if the timer and rebounds make the all-card clear attainable.
Repeat prey hunts. Use the three top lanes, two inlanes, and two standups to complete B-I-G G-A-M-E; use selected numbered drops for card patterns.

fallback.title: Card-pattern progress
fallback.when: Use this when prey selection is awkward but controlled drop targets are available.

steps.text: Select the card containing the safest useful numbered target.
Complete one card or one line on every card for 2x end-of-ball bonus.
Complete two cards or two lines on every card for 3x end-of-ball bonus.
Complete all three cards for Reserve Bonus, then protect the carried value.

alternatives.title: B-I-G G-A-M-E Jackpot
alternatives.when: Use this when the letters and upper-left saucer route are safer than the required prey targets.

steps.text: Collect B-I-G at the top, the second G and A at the standups, and M-E at the inlanes.
After completing the word, shoot the upper-left lane into the saucer.
Collect 5,000 per lit letter, 35,000 per completed word, and the timed 100,000 Jackpot when that setting is enabled.

buildsToward.title: Higher prey levels and Reserve Bonus

steps.text: Collect the single prey on level one.
Use later top-lane entries to launch every prey on the next level.
Select each prey's card and collect its matching numbered target.
Complete all three cards for carried Reserve Bonus while advancing the hunt.

techniques.name: Prey-card read
techniques.instruction: Read both the flashing prey number and its card before touching a bumper or numbered drop.

techniques.name: Hurry-up commitment
techniques.instruction: After the first drop, compare the timer with the two remaining rebounds; abandon an unsafe bank before the reset path costs the ball.

cautions.issue: The operator can limit simultaneous card selection to one, two, or three cards and reduce that limit after completed card sets.
cautions.response: Read selected-card lamps after every bumper hit instead of assuming all prior cards remain active.

cautions.issue: A timed drop bank can reset before completion, and liberal all-card credit is separately adjustable.
cautions.response: Confirm both settings before risking a second or third drop solely for cross-card progress.

cautions.issue: The upper saucer and paired-flipper feeds remain machine-dependent despite the rewritten rules.
cautions.response: Test the full far-left lane and saucer return before using the optional 100,000 Jackpot as the primary route.

checkBeforePlay: Check which ball enables the 5,000-per-line bonus and whether Extra Ball and Special convert to points.
Check the upper-saucer completion award before using that smaller collect as a scoring plan.
strategy.simpleOverview: In BigGame2022, a flashing top lane launches prey and the pop bumpers select its X, Y, or Z card. Hit the numbered drop that matches the prey to flush it, then hit the same number again for 20,000. Repeat prey hunts while useful card patterns build alongside them.
strategy.overview: BigGame2022 starts each prey hunt at a flashing top lane. Use the lower-left bumper for X, the lower-right bumper for Y, or five upper-bumper hits for Z, then hit the prey's numbered drop once to flush it and again to collect 20,000. Continue hunts while selected drops complete card lines and B-I-G G-A-M-E progress.
machineSetup: Check which ball enables the 5,000-per-line bonus and whether Extra Ball and Special convert to points.
Check the upper-saucer completion award before using that smaller collect as a scoring plan.

changes: The recode adds a prey hunt: a top lane launches prey, pop bumpers select its card, and two hits to the matching numbered drop collect it.
It adds a new skill shot, configurable card selection, drop-bank hurry-ups, liberal bank clears, and adjustable ball save.
Completing B-I-G G-A-M-E can qualify a timed 100,000 Jackpot at the upper-left lane and saucer.
